description: This Java class implements a command strategy for handling loan state transitions by external ID within the Fineract project. It processes batch requests to perform actions such as approval or disbursement on loans identified via external IDs, calling the Loans API resource accordingly.

classes.name: LoanStateTransistionsByExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to process loan state transition commands based on external ID, delegating to LoansApiResource and handling batch request/response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a BatchRequest to perform a loan state transition (e.g., approve/disburse) identified by external ID, utilizing regex parsing and delegating to LoansApiResource.
